_meta.description: Per-map entity ids of Evergaol bosses, for the proximity-wake emevd patch. The Evergaol encounter event (90015026) is excluded from the patch's encounter scan, and these eids are not all in fragile_slot_entities.json / nr_boss_slots.json, so without this catalog those bosses never get an EnableCharacterAI. Generated by dev/build_evergaol_wake_entities.py from nr_slot_inventory.json. Pure catalog inclusion — every Evergaol slot already has an entity id, so no stamping is involved.
